scope: Independent directed Playwright interactions on native Chromium WebGL. Desktop/mobile are viewport and touch emulation. Aggregate request metadata only; no raw map data, HAR or tile snapshots.
sourceReview: README, App, MapPanel, ShadowLayer, buildings, state, export, solar, Scene and Vite build reviewed read-only
No AGENTS.md found in project or available ancestors
Bounded geometry, conditional heights, incomplete state and privacy are disclosed; no automatic geolocation, analytics, geocoding, storage or tile snapshots
Build cancellation generations and cleanup reviewed; lifecycle runtime checks separately below

checks.name: public city-map initializes with no storage writes
map jump and keyboard skip target actual sections/first planner control
linked attribution and bounded-estimate/privacy wording
actual loaded building meshes visible
actual zoom, pitch toggle and north buttons
all available solar-event buttons preserve active model
time/keyboard changes preserve geometry and request no new tiles
keyboard map pan + centre changes point, clears model and preserves zone
actual marker drag changes coordinates
actual map point click changes coordinates
real inside-building point has honest unavailable choice
build-to-horizon unmount/remount leaves no stale model
local city search selection and no-hit recovery
explicit save/restore/delete preserves exact custom point but no coordinate URL
spring/fall DST day bounds apply to both map and solar controls
actual Download plan download retains unambiguous DST instant
actual Add to calendar download retains unambiguous DST instant
polar day/night remain distinct from unavailable event crossings
horizon 3D/2D and all headings return to fresh map under reduced motion
language and overflow check after full directed sequence
network host aggregate has only self-hosted application and disclosed map provider
